headline: GPT-6.1 Sol arrives after seven days, raising model velocity questions
body: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol just one week after GPT-6 Sol, citing near-Astra level performance improvements. For healthcare AI implementations, rapid model cycling creates operational friction: clinical teams deploying against specific model versions face retraining cycles, validation workflows stall, and EHR integration timelines compress. The velocity score of 88 across coverage suggests significant market attention, but healthcare organizations need stability guarantees and deprecation windows that match clinical validation timelines, not consumer product release schedules. This pattern signals vendors and health systems must architect model-agnostic pipelines rather than locking workflows to specific GPT versions.
